Read a single-layer vector file (GeoPackage or shapefile)

Source: R/vector_file.R
read_vector.Rd

Throws an error for GeoPackages with more than one layer, rather than letting st_read quietly pick the first.

Usage

read_vector(path, ...)

Arguments

path

Path to .gpkg or .shp

...

Additional arguments passed to st_read

Value

sf object
